{{Quote|Empire is winning, yes? Don't care who wins, just want war to be over.|Thadd|<ref name="They Came From the Sky" />}}
'''Thadd''' was a [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When the [[Battle of Corellia]] swept over the planet, Thadd sought to help end the war, and so traveled to the [[Imperial Garrison (Corellia)|Imperial Garrison]] in [[Axial Park]] in order to aid the then-winning [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] by telling them about the landing zone beacons that [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were using.
